Next, I will check "Yellow_Leaf", as the test image has some yellowing.

thought

Next, I will check "Brown_Spot".

thought

Next, I will check "Yellow_Spot".

thought

Next, I will check "Leaf_Scald".

thought
The reference image for Leaf_Scald shows a distinct white "pencil line" with a yellow border, which is not what is observed in the test image. The test image has more of a general mosaic pattern.

Next, I will check "Pokkah_Boeng", although its primary symptoms involve malformed leaves and stem issues, the `part_index.md` does list "leaf" as an affected part.

thought
The reference image for Pokkah_Boeng shows malformed and torn leaves, which is not consistent with the test image.

Now, I have used 6 of my 8 reference image views. I have two left. So far, Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus seems to be the best match. I will check "Grassy_Shoot" and "Sett_Rot" next, even though they are primarily "whole_plant" and "stem" diseases respectively, as per the part index. However, the instructions state to check other classes if current candidates are exhausted, and I still have budget. It's good to rule them out completely.

thought
The reference image for Grassy_Shoot shows a whole plant with numerous thin tillers and pale, narrow leaves, giving a bushy appearance. This is entirely different from the single leaf with a mosaic pattern in the test image.

Finally, I will check "Sett_Rot".

thought
The reference image for Sett_Rot shows a rotted stem base and dried leaves, which is not consistent with the test image.

Having viewed 8 reference images, "Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus" provides the closest visual match to the test image, showing a clear yellow and green mosaic pattern on the leaf.
